g.text: Sequence Diagram - Stop Stock Tracking and Preserve the Snapshot
SELECT stock row WHERE ended_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
Stopping tracking is a BCK09 operation on the Stock
resource. It does not update Product or set Product.isActive.
The final quantity is retained in this completed period,
including when greater than zero. A new POST /stock starts
a new period with a new StockId and startedAt. All prior
This flow reflects the client clarification: stock tracking
may be disabled at any balance. The period is closed by
setting endedAt; no stock information is deleted. A regular
decrease to zero does not call this operation; endedAt remains
empty and the period remains current.
